_comment: Bundled, offline-first security advisories. Ships in the repo so it is hashed by verify.json (signed) and synced as source. `hv doctor` surfaces a HIGH-severity advisory that applies to the bundled crypto or to an installed tool referenced by a cell. Owner-signed sync of advisories over the journal + an optional Ed25519-verified online feed are a planned extension; for now this file is the single offline source.
